! Game text
| The Mythrol's game text may not be canceled. If about to leave table, place out of play. During start of game, may reveal this card from outside your deck to replace a just-deployed Jabba's Prize imprisoned in Security Tower. If not revealed {{Errata hl|1=during start of game}}, place this card under your Starting Effect. [Set 1] Despair targets The Mythrol instead of Jabba's Prize. Cancels Stunning Leader here. If just released, either flip this card or place it out of play. || The Mythrol's game text may not be canceled. If about to leave table, place out of play. {{Errata hl|1=Plays only during}} start of game {{Errata hl|1=by revealing}} from outside your deck to replace a just-deployed Jabba's Prize imprisoned in Security Tower. If not revealed, place this card under your Starting Effect. [Set 1] Despair targets The Mythrol instead of Jabba's Prize. Cancels Stunning Leader here. If just released, either flip this card or place it out of play.

== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on every Virtual Modern [[The Mythrol / •The Mythrol]] article. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. One column per published text state; {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged from the previous column. Words a later column removed are highlighted in the column before it. Same-words image changes are not columns: [[The Mythrol / •The Mythrol (Errata)]] shares the [[The Mythrol / •The Mythrol]] column; [[The Mythrol / •The Mythrol (Errata 3)]] shares the [[The Mythrol / •The Mythrol (Errata 2)]] column; [[The Mythrol / •The Mythrol (Errata 4)]] shares the [[The Mythrol / •The Mythrol (Errata 2)]] column.
